children: Veracyte entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Convergent Genomics, adding the UroAmp test and urine tumor DNA technology to its portfolio. The deal closed on September 14, 2026, with $150 million paid in cash at closing and up to $30 million in additional cash tied to milestones related to publications and reimbursement. Convergent becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of Veracyte, enhancing the company's bladder cancer diagnostics roadmap.
